git.guard: HARD RULE 10, IMPORT-SCOPED: refuses if any src/instrument file this run IMPORTS is dirty. The repo-wide dirty list is recorded in full above.

framing.the_rule_is_published: Ji, Xue & Carin, IEEE TSP 2008 Sec. IV.A states the principal-axis rule verbatim, including the synthesise-or-snap fork; Info-Synth Prop. 1 gives the same direction. NOT this project's finding.
framing.v1_is_a_static_control: under linear-Gaussian the covariance update does not depend on the answer, so a pure Sigma-functional emitter cannot be adaptive: its sequence is the leading eigenvectors of the PRIOR, precomputable before the interview. This run is the STATIC CONTROL for the adaptivity claim, not a candidate method.
framing.what_is_ours: (i) the COMMON-vs-SPECIFIC decomposition of the measured-best direction; (ii) the ANSWERABILITY GAP -- the empirical size of Info-Synth's MI cost of snapping, which that work derives and never reports as a number. Where the gap is large the second-order surrogate is not the right quantity.

conventions.space: 200-d TOWER latent space, popularity-stripped exactly as c3b_adapter.TowerBridge: item = (Wd - mean(Wd)) - <.,u1>u1, concept = d_c, user latent = tower fold with the same u1 component removed
conventions.mean_removal: MEAN-REMOVED ON BOTH SIDES. Question side: the bank mean mean(Wd) is removed by construction. Cohort side: the covariance is taken about the cohort's OWN mean, so v1..v3 are mean-removed objects. A raw (uncentred Wd) robustness row is banked beside the headline.
conventions.sign: |cos| is the headline because an eigenvector's sign is arbitrary. The signed value uses the declared convention: v_j is oriented so the cohort's projection <z - zbar, v_j> has non-negative skew (positive on the side carrying the heavier tail of the cohort's spread).
conventions.cohort: the tree's OWN fit cohort at each node -- the users among the 10,000 TRAIN users the tree was grown on who reach that node, re-derived with ndcg_tree.branch_of and asserted against every banked n_users AND every banked child_sizes. This DEPARTS from c1_final's bank-cohort resolution because the gain tables were measured on this cohort (sweep n_rows == node n_users at 72/72).
conventions.latent: PRIMARY = `profile`, the tower fold of the user's whole fold-in profile (their full-information latent). SECONDARY = `belief`, genv_latent at the state's prefix (what the scorer holds; in a cold interview it is a function of the prefix answers only).

blend_provenance.note: bit-identity on the assembled 129-d vector is NOT attainable -- bank_vectors' matmul reassociates under a different thread count / batch width, the same 4.77e-07 constant the repair campaign recorded for |Ebank[pool2full] - Epool|.max(). The exact half of the gate covers everything this run actually consumes.

target_tower_disclosure.note: Ew rows carry their own magnitude, d_c rows are unit -- so in a mixed blend the nominal weight is not the effective one. Reported, not corrected: R_s is defined by the sheet in exactly these two objects.

target_diversity_tower_space.unit: the 2,556 unordered pairs of the 72 tower-space blend targets
target_diversity_tower_space.note: the tower analogue of C5's D1. It is what makes the state-blind leave-one-out null strong, and it must be read beside the headline.

COMMON_vs_SPECIFIC_decomposition.definition: the state's target is split into the state-BLIND direction (the leave-one-out mean of the other 71 unit targets) and the orthogonal state-SPECIFIC residual. If v1 tracks only the common half it is a static prior axis, not an adaptive probe.

variance_along_the_target.definition: (t' Sigma t) / (trace(Sigma)/d) -- 1.0 == a random direction. The form of the hypothesis that does NOT depend on v1 being a well-estimated axis.
